tiers: 1. Surdus: 2/combat, glyphic action; A creature within 60 feet is deafened for 1 minute as twisted, black roots creep out of their ears.
2. Creatures deafened by Surdus have -1 physical resistance.
3. Creatures deafened by Surdus have -1 resistance against armour attacks.
4. Non-boss creatures deafened by Surdus deal -2 damage.
5. The next limited power you use after using Surdus deals +6 damage.

6. If you use Surdus on a creature already deafened by Surdus, a Medium, untargetable spire of twisted, black fibre grows from the ground in an unoccupied space adjacent to the creature for 1 minute. Foes within 60 feet of the spire are deafened by Surdus.
7. If you use Surdus on a creature already deafened by Surdus, the bonus numeric effects of Surdus from this glyph path are tripled for that target.
8. When you use Surdus, you may consume an additional use of it (if available) to force the target to make a save, becoming dominated until the end of its next turn on a fail.
9. Creatures deafened by Surdus have -4 physical resistance if you have used a limited power since the start of your last turn.
10. When you use Surdus on a bloodied target, it has -2 physical resistance while deafened by Surdus.
1. Pyramis: 1/SR, glyphic action; You tear a microscopic hole in reality, unleashing an eruption of energy in a 30 foot cone that deals 3 glyphic damage.
2. Pyramis' base damage becomes 6.
3. Pyramis can now be used once per combat, but after the first time it is used between short rests, it does 1 less damage.
4. Pyramis' base damage becomes 8 and its cone size increases to 60 feet.
5. Pyramis now only damages foes.
6. After using Pyramis, you immediately teleport to any space in the furthest row of its area.
7. After using Pyramis, its effect repeats in the same area at the start of your next turn. Additionally, its base damage becomes 9.
8. When you use Pyramis, you recover either 2 spell slot levels or 2 exertion. Additionally, its base damage becomes 10.
9. Whenever Pyramis repeats, roll a d4. On a 4, the repeat's damage is doubled.
10. Whenever Pyramis' repeat's damage is doubled, quadruple it instead.
1. Concursus: 1/combat, glyphic action; A prismatic spike of chaotic power erupts from your body towards a creature adjacent to you, dealing 6 glyphic damage to it.
2. Concursus' base damage becomes 12.
3. When you use Concursus, the target must make a save, becoming staggered for 1 round on a fail. Additionally, its base damage becomes 13.
4. When you use Concursus, the target takes 3 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until it passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
5. Concursus deals +7 damage against targets with any resistances or immunities.
6. Creatures have a -1 penalty to any saves they make against Concursus' effects. Additionally, its base damage becomes 15.
7. Concursus splashes 2 damage and creatures have a -1 penalty to passive saves to end Concursus' ongoing damage.

8. When you use Concursus, the target must make a save, becoming slowed for 1 round on a fail. Additionally, creatures have a -1 penalty to saves against Concursus' stagger. Additionally, its base damage becomes 16.
9. Concursus can now be used twice per combat. Additionally, its base damage becomes 18.
10. Concursus deals +3 damage for each condition or instance of ongoing damage inflicted by itself that the target is currently affected by.

1. Cohibere: 2/combat, glyphic action; A tentacle emerges from beneath your equipment, attempting to wrap around a creature adjacent to you. The creature must make a save, becoming restrained for 1 round, or until you move away from them, on a fail.
2. Whenever you restrain a creature with Cohibere, gain +2 reflex for 1 round.

3. Whenever you restrain a creature with Cohibere, the creature takes 2 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until it passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses). Additionally, when the restrain ends, you gain +10' speed for 1 round.
4. You may use as many uses of Cohibere as you wish within the one glyphic action.
5. Creatures restrained by Cohibere have -2 resistance to armour attacks. This is increased to -4 if you've used a limited power since the start of your last turn.
6. Whenever Cohibere's restrain ends on a creature, that creature has -4 resistance to armour attacks for 1 round.

7. Whenever you are hit while restraining a creature with Cohibere, all Cohibere restrains immediately end and you erupt in glyphic power, dealing 9 glyphic damage to all foes adjacent to you for each restrain that ended.
8. Whenever you use Cohibere, its glyphic action is refunded. Additionally, whenever Cohibere's restrain ends, gain 5 temporary HP.
9. Upon using a limited power that targets a single adjacent creature, you may choose to immediately use Cohibere on that creature as a free action without expending any of its uses.
10. The explosion when you are hit while restraining a creature with Cohibere deals +2 damage and has +5' radius for each complete turn that the restrain was active for.

1. Fortificare: 1/combat, glyphic action; You manifest a floating suit of armour made from tiny castle walls and structures that orbits a creature within 60' of you for 1 round. This grants them +1 armour.
2. Creatures affected by Fortificare deal +3 damage.
3. Creatures affected by Fortificare deal +3 damage.
4. Whenever you use Fortificare, its glyphic action is refunded.
5. The damaging attacks of creatures affected by Fortificare deal +1d4 bludgeoning damage.

6. Whenever a creature affected by Fortificare hits with an attack, they inflict 3 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
7. The damaging attacks of creatures affected by Fortificare now scale with minion damage stats, in addition to their usual scaling. Additionally, those same creatures have +3 minion damage.
8. Creatures affected by Fortificare have +13 critical damage bonus.
9. While a creature has an active instance of ongoing damage caused by Fortificare, they deal +2 damage.
10. When a creature affected by Fortificare scores a critical hit, the Fortificare on them lasts until the end of combat.
1. Tolerare: 2/combat, glyphic action; You cause a creature within 60' of you to swell with muscle and flesh for 1 round, granting them +1 fortitude.
2. Creatures affected by Tolerare have +5 critical damage bonus and +5' Speed.
3. Whenever a creature affected by Tolerare hits with an attack, they inflict 2 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
4. Creatures affected by Tolerare deal +2 damage.
5. Creatures affected by Tolerare deal +2 damage.
6. Whenever you use Tolerare, its glyphic action is refunded.
7. If a creature's fortitude is its highest defence while affected by Tolerare, it gains +5 resistance against fortitude attacks.
8. Creatures affected by Tolerare have +5 resistance against fortitude attacks.
9. Creatures affected by Tolerare have +7 critical damage bonus and recover 7 HP whenever the score a critical hit.
10. Creatures affected by Tolerare deal +3 damage.
1. Velox: 2/combat, glyphic action; You conjure a small storm that whips around a creature within 60' of you, granting them +1 reflex for 1 round.
2. Creatures affected by Velox have +1 reflex.
3. Velox now also affects all allies adjacent to the target.
4. Whenever a creature affected by Velox is targeted by a reflex attack, Velox lasts on it until the end of combat.
5. Whenever Velox ends on a creature, they release a wave of water around them that deals 5 glyphic damage to all adjacent foes.
6. Whenever Velox ends on a creature, they release a 5'x5' twister centred on their space. The twister is a persistent zone that deals 3 glyphic damage to foes.
7. Creatures affected by Velox have +3 resistance against reflex attacks for each instance of Velox they have been affected by this combat.

8. For each round of the current combat that passes without you using Velox, your next use of Velox this combat will trigger that number of additional times, which still cost additional uses of the power.
9. While at least 2 creatures are affected by Velox, a bolt of lightning strikes a random foe adjacent to a creature affected by Velox at the start of each of your turns, dealing 9 glyphic damage.
10. Bolts of lightning can now be triggered by Velox while at least only 1 creature is affected by Velox.
1. Voluntas: 2/combat, glyphic action; You invoke a surge of awesome confidence in a creature within 60' of you, granting them +1 will for 1 round.
2. Voluntas now also affects all allies adjacent to the target.
3. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target are pushed 10' away from them.
4. Creatures affected by Voluntas have +2 resistance.
5. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target deal -2 damage for 1 round.
6. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target must make a save, becoming staggered for 1 round on a fail.
7. Whenever you use Voluntas, the target is healed for 2 HP, or 5 HP if they are bloodied.
8. Whenever you use Voluntas, all foes adjacent to the target take 3 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until they pass a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
9. Creatures staggered by Voluntas have -2 resistance.
10. Whenever you use Voluntas, the next limited power the target uses deals +7 damage.
1. Motus: 1/SR, glyphic action; You move a willing creature within 60' of you with great speed. They immediately shift up to 10'.

2. When the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, that creature takes 4 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until they pass a passive save (this scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
3. When the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, that creature takes 7 glyphic damage.
4. All damage dealt by Motus is increased by 2, and whenever Motus deals non-ongoing damage, the target of Motus heals 2 HP.
5. Whenever you use Motus on a creature, that creature gains +15' speed for 1 round.
6. The non-ongoing damage dealt by Motus is increased by 7 against targets taking ongoing damage.
7. If the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, the maximum shift distance increases by 15'.
8. Whenever you use Motus on a creature, that creature deals +8 damage with their next limited power.

9. When the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, leave a Shadow of that creature in the space they left. This Shadow acts like a CR 1/4 minion, but doesn't require your concentration and only scales with glyphic damage, no other stats.
10. The the target of Motus moves out of the reach of a creature of your choice, the maximum shift distance increases by 15'.
1. Verto: 1/SR, glyphic action; You forcibly tear open the material plane, swapping spaces with a creature within 10' of you.
2. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, you may deal 6 glyphic damage to the other creature.
3. Verto's range becomes 20'.

4. At the start of your next turn after using Verto, you may choose to swap with the same creature again, so long as they are still within Verto's range. If the creature is dead, you may instead swap with any other creature within range.
5. At the start of your turn two rounds after using Verto, you may choose to swap with the same creature again, regardless of range.
6. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, you may inflict 3 ongoing glyphic damage to the other creature, stacking until they pass a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
7. Verto's cooldown becomes 1/combat and its base damage on swap becomes 7.
8. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, you may give the other creature -20' speed for 1 round.
9. Whenever you swap spaces with Verto, the other creature becomes Sluggish for the remainder of combat.
10. Verto's range becomes 25' and all damage it deals is increased by 2.
1. Salvare: 1/combat, glyphic action; You surround a creature within 60' of you with a faint glow for 1 round, absorbing some of the negative energy around them. This grants the target +1 to saves.
2. Salvare now lasts for the remainder of combat.
3. Attacks that can inflict the frightened condition have -1 AB against creatures affected by Salvare. Additionally, those creatures have +1 resistance to will attacks.
4. Creatures affected by Salvare have +3 resistance to non-armour attacks.
5. From the second round of Salvare's effect and onwards, the target has +1 physical resistance and +1 resistance.
6. As a free action on your turn, you may immediately end Salvare's effect to cause negative energy to erupt from the target's body. All foes adjacent to the target take 15 glyphic damage.
7. Creatures affected by Salvare have +1 passive regeneration and +1 resistance to non-armour attacks.
8. If Salvare affects a creature for at least 2 rounds, it retains all resistance bonuses acquired from Salvare until it either takes a short rest or is affected by Salvare again.
9. The passive regeneration bonus granted by Salvare is increased to +3.
10. Creatures affected by Salvare cannot lose concentration against their will.
1. Sonticus: 2/combat, glyphic action; You sharpen the extremeties of a creature within 60' of you for 1 round, granting them +1 critical hit range.
2. Creatures affected by Sonticus deal +1d10 piercing damage with their critical hits.
3. Whenever you use Sonticus, the target is healed 4 HP.
4. Creatures affected by Sonticus have +4 DoT damage.
5. Whenever a creature affected by Sonticus scores a critical hit, the target gets -3 physical resistance for 1 round.
6. Creatures affected by Sonticus have +9 critical damage bonus.
7. Sonticus' critical hit range bonus is increased to +2, and its critical damage bonus is increased to +11.

8. Whenever you use Sonticus, create a Shadow of the target in an unoccupied space adjacent to them. This Shadow acts like a CR 1/8 minion, but doesn't require your concentration and only scales with glyphic damage, no other stats.
9. Whenever you use Sonticus, the target regains either 2 spell slot levels or 2 exertion.

10. After a creature affected by Sonticus makes a damaging attack while there is a living Shadow of them, they may immediately kill the shadow to grant that attack +2 critical hit range and +3 critical damage bonus.

1. Murus: 1/SR, glyphic action; You conjure a 2'-high wall of dark smoke-like gas made up of up to 1 connected space (no diagonal connections), in any arrangement of your choosing, which lasts for the remainder of combat. You must have line of sight to at least one of the wall's spaces, and all spaces must be within 60' of you. The wall is a persistent zone that deals 3 glyphic damage.
2. The length of Murus is now up to 2 connected spaces.
3. At the start of each of your turns, you can extend Murus by 1 space.
4. Creatures inside Murus have -2 damage.
5. Whenever you use Murus, you may shift up to 10' away from its area.
6. You deal +2 damage to creatures inside Murus.
7. Your attacks have +1 critical hit range against targets inside Murus.
8. Whenever you use Murus, you gain +1 reflex for 1 round and gain 6 temporary HP if you receive a reflex attack during that time.

9. At the start of each of your turns, a Shadow of you appears in a random unoccupied space of Murus. This Shadow acts like a CR 1 minion, but doesn't require your concentration and only scales with glyphic damage, no other stats.
10. Whenever you use Murus, remove all conditions from yourself. Additionally, you deal +2 damage to creatures inside Murus.
1. Impes: 1/combat, glyphic action; You warp time to rapidly move up to 10' in a straight line and then deal 2 glyphic damage to a creature adjacent to you.
2. Impes' base damage becomes 8.
3. Impes' base movement increase to 25'.
4. Whenever you deal damage with Impes, the target becomes sluggish for 1 round. Additionally, Impes' base damage becomes 10.
5. Whenever you deal damage with Impes, you also deal 3 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
6. Impes' ongoing damage increases to 6.
7. While a creature is sluggish from Impes, any sluggish it would inflict instead doubles the target's speed. Additionally, Impes' base damage becomes 11.
8. Whenever you deal damage with Impes, the target makes a save, becoming blinded for 1 round on a fail. Additionally, Impes' base damage becomes 14.
9. Impes' base damage becomes 20.
10. Whenever you deal damage with Impes, you and allies adjacent to the target heal 8 HP.

1. Conculco: 1/LR, glyphic action; You become momentarily incorporeal and ghastly, shifting up to 10'. While shifting in this way, you can pass through the spaces of hostile creatures, but cannot end the movement there. Any creature you passed through must make a save, taking 1 glyphic damage on a fail.
2. Whenever you use Conculco, its glyphic action is refunded.
3. Conculco's base damage becomes 5 and whenever it deals damage, the target must make a save, becoming debilitated for 1 round on a fail.
4. Whenever Conculco would deal damage, roll a d4. On a 4, the damage is doubled. Additionally, Conculco's base damage becomes 8.

5. Whenever Conculco deals damage, it deals 3 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses). Additionally, whenever Conculco deals damage, the target becomes sluggish for 1 round.
6. Conculco's maximum shift distance increases to 20'.
7. Whenever you use Conculco, your next limited power ignores damage resistance and has its area doubled.

8. Whenever you would use Conculco, you can choose to instead create an incorporeal Spectral Obelisk in an unoccupied space adjacent to you that remains for the remainder of combat, using Conculco at the end of each of your turns. Additionally, Conculco's base damage becomes 9.
9. Whenever Conculco's damage is doubled, it is tripled instead. Additionally, Conculco's base damage becomes 11.
10. Whenever you use Conculco to create a Spectral Obelisk, you create two Obelisks instead, in two unoccupied spaces adjacent to you. Additionally, Conculco's base damage becomes 13.
1. Repugnantia: 1/SR, glyphic action; You surround a creature within 60' of you with a shimmering orb for 1 round, granting it +3 resistance.
2. Repugnantia can now be used once per combat.
3. Whenever you use Repugnantia, you recover either 2 spell slot levels or 2 exertion.
4. Whenever a creature affected by Repugnantia is hit, Repugnantia's cooldown is refreshed.
5. Whenever a creature affected by Repugnantia is hit, the attacker gets -4 damage for 1 round.
6. While you are adjacent to a creature affected by Repugnantia, it gains +3 resistance.
7. Whenever you use Repugnantia, the target heals 6 HP.
8. You can now target 1 additional creature with Repugnantia that is within 10' of the original target.

9. Whenever a creature affected by Repugnantia goes down, a Shadow of them is created in an unoccupied space adjacent to them. This Shadow acts like a CR 1 minion, but doesn't require your concentration and only scales with glyphic damage, no other stats.
10. Whenever Repgunantia heals its target, they also gain 9 temporary HP.
1. Cado: 2/combat, glyphic action; An invisible blast of energy erupts from your body towards a creature within 60' of you, knocking it prone.
2. If you have used Cado this turn, your hits force their targets to make a save, staggering the target for 1 round on a fail.
3. Whenever you use Cado, you gain 5 temporary HP.
4. Whenever Cado knocks a creature prone, the target must make a save, becoming staggered for 1 round on a fail.
5. You can now target 1 additional creature with Cado that is within 5' of the original target.
6. Whenever Cado knocks a creature prone, you deal 2 ongoing glyphic damage to the target, stacking until it passes a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
7. Whenever Cado knocks a creature prone, the energy splits into a 15' cone originating from them, aiming in the direction opposite from you. This cone deals 3 glyphic damage to foes.
8. Whenever a creature knocked prone by Cado stands up, they are immediately knocked prone by Cado. Additionally, creatures knocked prone by Cado have -5' speed.
9. Cado's ongoing damage becomes 5.
10. Cado's ongoing damage becomes 8.
1. Lassitudo: 1/combat, glyphic action; You sap the energy from a creature within 60' of you, forcing it to make a save. On a fail, it gains a level of fatigue.
2. Whenever you use Lassitudo during the first round of combat, it no longer requires a save. Additionally, creatures have -1 to their saves against Lassitudo.
3. Lassitudo inflicts 2 levels of fatigue.

4. Creatures affected by Lassitudo must make passive saves, gaining an additional level of fatigue and ending the passive saves upon failing one. Additionally, creatures have -1 to their saves against Lassitudo.
5. Creatures affected by Lassitudo have -1 physical damage and become slowed for 1 round when struck by a major hit.
6. Lassitudo inflicts 3 levels of fatigue.
7. Lassitudo now targets 1 additional creature within 10' of the original target.
8. The additional level of fatigue Lassitudo inflicts on a failed passive save is increased to 2 levels of fatigue.
9. Creatures have -2 on their saves against Lassitudo, and a further -1 on their passive saves against it.
10. Lassitudo inflicts 1 additional level of fatigue against creatures already affected by a condition. Additionally, creatures have -1 on their saves against Lassitudo.
1. Discordia: 1/combat, glyphic action; You manifest malicious voices in the mind of a creature within 60' of you, forcing it to make a save. On a fail, it gains a level of strife.
2. Discordia can now be used twice per combat.
3. Whenever you inflict strife with Discordia, the target is also debilitated for 1 round.
4. Creatures affected by Discordia have -1 resistance.
5. Whenever you use Discordia, its glyphic action is refunded.
6. Discordia now targets 1 additional creature adjacent to the original target.
7. Whenever a creature affected by Discordia dies, it erupts in a burst of paranoia, dealing 11 glyphic damage to all of your foes adjacent to it.
8. Discordia inflicts 1 additional level of strife against bosses. Additionally, creatures have -1 to saves against Discordia.
9. Creatures affected by Discordia have -1 non-physical resistance. Additionally, creatures have -1 to saves against Discordia.
10. The debilitated condition inflicted by Discordia now lasts for as long as the creature is affected by Discordia. Additionally, creatures affected by Discordia have -1 non-physical resistance.
1. Ruptis: 1/LR, glyphic action; You release a nova of black energy, dealing 7 glyphic damage to all creatures within 5' of you.
2. Whenever you use Ruptis, the target takes 4 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until it passes a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
3. Ruptis' area is increased to 10'.
4. Whenever you use Ruptis, heal 4 HP. Additionally, Ruptis' base damage becomes 10.
5. Whenever you score a critical success with a limited power, Ruptis' cooldown is refreshed.
6. Whenever you use Ruptis, the target gets -2 resistance for 1 round.
7. Whenever you use Ruptis, the target gets -2 resistance for 1 round.
8. Whenever you use Ruptis, your next limited power deals +9 damage.
9. While you have at least one completed glyph path, Ruptis deals +9 damage.

10. Whenever Ruptis scores a killing blow, an untargetable, black, twisted spire erupts from the corpse. The spire uses Ruptis at the end of each of your turns. Additionally, Ruptis' base damage becomes 15.
1. Impedimentum: 1/SR, glyphic action; You create a 5'x5' area of tangling vines, causing difficult terrain that lasts for the remainder of combat in a space within 60' of you.
2. Impedimentum is now a persistent zone that deals 3 glyphic damage.
3. Creatures in Impedimentum have -5' speed. Additionally, Impedimentum's base damage becomes 4.
4. Impedimentum's base damage becomes 7.
5. Whenever Impedimentum scores a killing blow, you gain +25' speed for 1 round.
6. Creatures in Impedimentum has -5' speed. Additionally, Impedimentum's base damage becomes 8.
7. Impedimentum's base damage becomes 12.
8. Whenever Impedimentum scores a killing blow, its size increases by 5' in all directions and its damage increases by 2.

9. When Impedimentum first appears, it immediately deals 4 ongoing glyphic damage to any creatures inside it, stacking until the target passes a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
10. Impedimentum's persistent zone applies -10' speed until the target leaves the zone.
1. Tractus: 1/LR, glyphic action; You shoot a black bolt of energy at a creature within 60' of you, dealing 7 glyphic damage.
2. Tractus can now be used once per short rest.
3. Tractus deals +10 damage against targets with full HP.
4. Tractus' base damage becomes 10, and it deals +4 damage against bloodied targets.

5. Whenever Tractus scores a killing blow, it leaves a beam of energy, a 15'x15' persistent zone, centered on the target. The zone deals 2 glyphic damage to foes. Additionally, Tractus' base damage becomes 11.
6. Tractus' base damage becomes 12, and its energy beam's damage becomes 4.
7. Tractus' energy beam's damage becomes 6. Additionally, its base damage becomes 14.
8. Whenever Tractus damages a boss or scores a killing blow against a non-boss, you heal 6 HP.
9. Whenever Tractus creates an energy beam, it instead creates two on top of each other. These areas each move 5' in a random direction at the end of each of your turns.
10. Whenever Tractus damages a boss or scores a killing blow against a non-boss, you gain +15' speed for 1 round. Additionally, its base damage becomes 15.
1. Pedem: 1/combat, glyphic action; Tendrils emerge from beneath your equipment, grappling a creature adjacent to you for 1 round as they lock it in place beside you.
2. Creatures affected by Pedem have -2 resistance vs you. Additionally, after using Pedem, you can move yourself and the target 5'.
3. Creatures affected by Pedem have -3 resistance vs you.
4. Whenever you use Pedem, its glyphic action is refunded.
5. You can use Pedem twice per combat.
6. Creatures affected by Pedem have -3 resistance vs you if they have a condition other than grappled.
7. Creatures affected by Pedem have -3 resistance vs you.
8. Pedem can also target another creature adjacent to the original target. Additionally, creatures affected by Pedem have -1 resistance vs you.
9. Whenever you grapple a creature with Pedem, roll a d4. On a 4, it restrains instead. Additionally, creatures affected by Pedem have -3 resistance vs you.
10. Whenever you restrain a creature with Pedem, they are also Staggered for 1 round.

1. Imperium: 1/SR, glyphic action; You force a creature within 60' of you to regurgitate a black, writhing mass of sludge, which lunges at another creature within 60' of the first creature. This deals 6 glyphic damage to the second creature. This counts as the first creature's damage, not yours.
2. Whenever you use Imperium, its glyphic action is refunded.
3. Imperium's base damage becomes 11.
4. Whenever you use Imperium, the next limited power the first creature uses before the end of its next turn deals +6 damage.
5. Whenever you use Imperium, black sludge erupts from the first creature's orifices, dealing 5 glyphic damage to all foes adjacent to it.
6. Whenever Imperium deals its base damage, the target takes 3 ongoing glyphic damage, stacking until the target passes a passive save (this damage scales with all glyphic damage bonuses).
7. Imperium's base damage becomes 17.
8. Whenever Imperium deals its base damage, the target makes a save, becoming staggered for 1 round on a fail. Additionally, its base damage becomes 18.
9. Imperium's ongoing damage becomes 7.
10. Imperium's base damage becomes 26.
1. Quadrantal: 1/SR, glyphic action; All creatures within a 15' cube, of which at least one space must be adjacent to you, take 3 glyphic damage.
2. Whenever Quadrantal damages at least one creature, gain 7 temporary HP.
3. Whenever Quadrantal damages at least one creature, recover 2 spell slot levels or 2 exertion.
4. Quadrantal deals additional damage equal to half the highest level unused spell slot you have or half your current exertion, whichever is higher. Additionally, Quadrantal's base damage becomes 4.
5. Whenever Quadrantal damages at least one creature, gain 7 temporary HP.
6. Whenever you use Quadrantal, its glyphic action is refunded.
7. While your highest-level spell slot is unused or you are on full exertion, roll a d4 whenever you use Quadrantal. On a 4, it deals double damage. Additionally, Quadrantal's base damage becomes 5.
8. While you have no spell slots or exertion remaining, Quadrantal can be used at-will.
9. Quadrantal's cube area becomes 30'.
10. Quadrantal's damage is now doubled on a 3+ on the d4. Additionally, Quadrantal's base damage becomes 6.
